name: Set Gaming Network Responsiveness
description: Sets Windows to prioritize foreground tasks over background processes for lower latency in games and voice chat. This does not increase internet speed or bandwidth.

description_i18n.en: Sets Windows to prioritize foreground tasks over background processes for lower latency in games and voice chat. This does not increase internet speed or bandwidth.
description_i18n.de: Stellt Windows so ein, dass Vordergrundaufgaben Vorrang vor Hintergrundprozessen erhalten für geringere Latenz bei Spielen und Voice-Chat. Dies erhöht nicht die Internetgeschwindigkeit oder Bandbreite.
description_i18n.fr: Configuré Windows pour prioriser les tâches au premier plan par rapport aux processus en arrière-plan afin de réduire la latence dans les jeux et le chat vocal. Cela n'augmente pas la vitesse d'internet ni la bande passante.

warnings.title: Reboot recommended
warnings.message: A system restart is required so Windows fully applies the changed network responsiveness behavior

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Modifies the registry value SystemResponsiveness under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile to control scheduling priority for multimedia and background workloads
